_comment: How the voice generator should read text. Numbers, dates, phone numbers and spelled names are handled by tools/spoken.mjs; this file holds the exceptions. 'exact' replaces a whole English sentence; 'replace' swaps a fragment in English text; 'replaceFa' swaps a fragment in Farsi text. The letters of the alphabet are in 'exact' with a full stop after them ("A."), so that each is read as the name of the letter standing alone: the letter A must not sound like the article "a".
